fact_text: The analyst's payout guide lists company payouts over the past two to three years and the returns investors base their stock choices on, so investors can screen for dividend-paying stocks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: Older large institutional investors focus on growth in total assets and equity (book value) rather than the price earnings multiple, which newer investors tend to emphasise.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: The analyst's screen checks that total assets and equity rise year on year, for example from 2021 to 2022 and from 2022 to 2023, alongside the dividend record.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: The analyst said companies with steadily rising plant, property and equipment each quarter and year tend to outperform, and that this growth in the total asset base is the basis of value investing.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: Textile composites often pay little or no dividend, so the analyst said investors should judge them by steady growth in equity and total assets instead of the payout.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: Gul Ahmed Textile showed steadily rising equity and total assets, which the analyst said could make it a fundamental value candidate even if its dividend record is small.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: In the sugar sector a company can show rising total assets and equity even when its dividend payout is weak, so the analyst said sugar makers should be screened on asset and equity growth.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: Shahmurad Sugar is noted for the highest sugar extraction yield from cane, and its asset and equity growth is visible, which the analyst said is the stronger test than payout.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: Power distribution is widely covered but poorly understood, so the analyst suggested an easy approach: read the dividend record together with the growth in assets and equity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: The analyst used Hub Power as the model power company for the dividend and asset and equity growth approach, describing it as a strong dividend payer.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: The analyst said value investing remains useful in an early stage of market recovery, when sentiment is still weak, as of 7 June 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)

fact_text: The analyst advised investors to read the full sector-wise payout report and examine each company's fundamentals before choosing dividend and value stocks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Ultimate Payout Guide for PSX  Pakistan Stock Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-06-07)
